outcome: duration of labor after 4 centimeters of dilation
cohort: Participants were multiparous patients with a history of one prior vaginal delivery, carrying a singleton gestation >=37 weeks, admitted for induction or spontaneous labor at an academic medical center between 2004 and 2015.
finding: Multiparas with an interpregnancy interval >3 years may experience a slower active phase when undergoing induction of labor, though interpregnancy interval did not demonstrate an effect on the length of the second stage.
